notes.text: The sheet recapitulates operations numbered 0 through 7, with marginal labels of irreversibility, weak strengthening or weakening, and réversible = anodin. These are the author’s classifications. They are transcribed here; no proof of the geometric classifications was attempted on this page.

Item2 states restriction from the written cyclic group to a divisor-sized group, with r_a/r′_a=d_a possible choices and d_a>1. The margin contains overworked relations and a crossed word; their uncertainty is retained. The displayed choice count is carried as source background, not independently proved in this reading.

Item3 writes a target quotient whose final Z has no separate a index; its numerator remains Z|Z_a because the foot is overworked. Both indices are distinct on the preceding source quotient. No missing index has been supplied from the expected group construction.

The footnote asks whether operation6 should be divided according to r_a=0 or r_a≠0, or whether the zero case should be excluded. The extra two-stroke group before exclure is retained as unsure{equals|cancelled ou}; the proposal does not answer the author’s question.

The main reader reports that the clear equals in 148_scan063 same_temps has the same straight upper bar and wavy lower bar as the extra group in this footnote. Reader_b did not open that page. This reported handwriting comparison strengthens the leading equals reading but is not a mathematical proof or a reason to erase the local alternative.

There are 20 distinct evidence places and 24 retained crop files. All 20 initial crops were inspected. Four retained _full versions complete upper boundaries in the two item1 crops, the combined item2 heading/body, and the full-width raised item0/item1-qualification run. The original crop files remain unchanged. These extensions completed evidence boundaries and were not a blind second audit. Original and prepared halves were each viewed once.

The marginal rules are open upper/right boundaries or oblique separators, rather than closed boxes around all the text. They are represented with open TikZ paths or separator rules. One brace joins the actual circled items4 and5; C’s extra repeated numerals are removed. Underlining is restricted to the strokes seen.

The pale lower folio reads 60. Its hand is recorded as unnamed and its attribution uncertain; pale appearance alone does not establish who wrote it. The ordinary mathematical sheet, including cancelled passages, remains classified as text.

The heading has no ink underline. H’s emphasis wrapper on that heading is treated as typographical editorial styling and excluded from the material collation; no underline is invented. By contrast, the two separate diagonal strokes of the integer Z are actual alphabet evidence and are recorded in the quotient collation.
